u0: Episodes always start here holding the box; no fall has happened since the last pickup. Track the schedule: the first fall will occur within a few steps no matter what you do. Keep control of the siren as needed and work toward the bottom-right exit, but do not step onto it yet: this state does not complete the task. If the box falls, you move to the post-fall state.
u1: The box has just fallen and is no longer in your hands. The next priority is to pick it up immediately: use the pickup action on the very next step, since the fall turns you to face its landing cell. Until you hold the box again, any exit arrival is unrewarded. Do not delay or toggle around while the box is on the floor.
u2: You are carrying the box after having recovered it from a fall; no fall has occurred since that recovery. Continue toward the exit, but stay alert for a possible second fall and be ready to pick the box up on the step right after it. Reaching the exit now with the box in hand and the siren silent will complete the task; reaching it otherwise only ends the episode without the full reward.
u3: The box has fallen again after you had recovered it once, and you are empty-handed. As before, pick it up on the very next step; the fall has turned you to face it. Do not head for or step onto the exit until the box is back in your hands, and do not linger while it lies on the floor.
u4: The episode has ended without satisfying the full exit conditions, so the main task objective cannot be completed anymore. No further reward is available; any remaining action is moot, though the environment may still accept actions until it cuts off.
u5: The task has been completed: you reached the exit with the box in your hands and the siren silent. The episode is over, and no further objective remains.
